run_scripts.run_all_pipelines
=============================

.. py:module:: run_scripts.run_all_pipelines

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Script to run all pipelines in sequence, given a JSON configuration file.

   Treat scripts as "executables" and call them with subprocess.

.. py:function:: remove_missing_data(df: pandas.DataFrame, drop_rows: bool = True, drop_cols: bool = False, inplace: bool = False) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Remove rows and/or columns containing any missing values.

   :param df: Input DataFrame
   :type df: pd.DataFrame
   :param drop_rows: If True, drop rows with any NaN
   :type drop_rows: bool
   :param drop_cols: If True, drop columns with any NaN
   :type drop_cols: bool
   :param inplace: If True, modify df in place
   :type inplace: bool

   :returns: Cleaned DataFrame (or None if inplace=True)
   :rtype: pd.DataFrame
